messages:
Mia (Marketing): quick heads-up — we have the Novagen customer interview tomorrow 10:00am PT. Need legal signoff on two short snippets and greenlight for a webinar follow-up.
Raj (Growth): noted, I'll round up the webinar invite list after we lock the quotes.
Olivia (Content): can we get the exact sentence(s) we want to pull? i can prep a 30–45s soundbite.
Samir (Product): pls flag any product claims — Novagen mentioned ~2x throughput on dedicated. if we cite that, i need the benchmark doc linked.
Mia (Marketing): thanks — snippet candidates below. 1) "Redwood cut inference cost 40% for our peak jobs" 2) "Predictable latency at scale was a game-changer" — want both cleared.
Tess (Legal): @Mia send the full interview transcript or the exact timestamped audio clip for each snippet. Legal needs attribution and to ensure no forward-looking promises.
Mia (Marketing): sending a short clip now via Drive link: https://drive.redwood/novagen/interview_clip_10am.mp3 — clip contains both lines.
Olivia (Content): plan: 2 social cards + 1 short blog + webinar CTA. If legal only approves one snippet, we’ll use the other as a paraphrase with product approval.
Samir (Product): attaching the benchmark table in thread (will DM the file). If we mention 2x, include note: "for our workload pattern (long seq, batching)".
Tess (Legal): ok to proceed with snippet 1 as-is. snippet 2 needs qualifier. Suggest wording: "Predictable tail latency at scale helped us maintain SLAs." Approve once @Samir confirms qualifier.
Mia (Marketing): got it. @Samir can you confirm qualifier by EOD? we want to publish the short post + webinar invite Tue morning.
Raj (Growth): timeline works for me. I'll draft the invite and route to partnerships for their aks.
Samir (Product): confirmed — qualifier is accurate. Approved.
Tess (Legal): final signoff granted for the two approved lines (with qualifier). Send me the final assets before publish.
Olivia (Content): will share Figma cards and blog draft by 5pm. Mia, want to review before i route to Tess?
Mia (Marketing): yes please. also: OpsBot will run the webinar room check at 9:30am day-of — opsbot noted. :thumbsup:
OpsBot: Reminder scheduled: webinar room check on 2024-09-14 16:30 UTC (9:30am PT).
Mia (Marketing): perfect. thanks team — i'll stitch the assets and confirm publish schedule once olivia posts the drafts. :rocket:
